## Episode Thesis

The episode is a political interview with Liberal labour market minister Johan Britz about Swedish savings policy ahead of the election. It covers raising the tax-free ISK allowance to SEK 500k, cutting the ISK flat-rate tax surcharge, and opposing left-wing proposals for wealth, billionaire and capital taxes. The host argues for a cap on the ISK interest-rate basis, since rising rates raise the tax just as markets tend to fall. Companies are only mentioned in passing, and no stock recommendations are made.
